game: Grand Theft Auto: Vice City - The Definitive Edition

findings.name: Hidden Packages
findings.detail: 100 total: Vice City Beach 45, Prawn Island 5, Starfish Island 5, Vice City Mainland 45. $100 each; $100,000 bonus for the 100th (GTAIntel, original-game guide).
findings.trackable: Not confirmed where DE Stats menu shows it. Achievements 'Scouring the City!' (50) and 'City Sleuth' (100) exist on Xbox/PC.

findings.name: Hidden Package milestone rewards
findings.detail: Per each 10: 10 body armor, 20 chainsaw, 30 Python, 40 flamethrower, 50 sniper (name varies by source), 60 minigun, 70 rocket launcher, 80 Sea Sparrow, 90 Rhino, 100 Hunter + $100,000. Spawn at safehouses (Ocean View Hotel, Vercetti Estate, Hyman Condo); Hunter/cash reportedly at Fort Baxter. Details differ between sources.
sources: web search summary of progameguides/sportskeeda (pages not fetched, one 403)

findings.name: Rampages
findings.detail: 35 total: Vice City Beach 17, Starfish Island 1, Vice City Mainland 17.

findings.name: Unique Stunt Jumps
findings.detail: 36 total: Vice City Beach 18, Prawn Island 1, Starfish Island 1, Vice City Mainland 16. Trophy/achievement 'Daredevil' = all 36.

findings.name: Store robberies
findings.detail: 15 stores for 100%. Achievement 'Put 'Em Up' = knock off 15 stores (Xbox/PC list; not in PS 34-trophy list).

findings.name: Vehicle missions (Vigilante, Paramedic, Firefighter, Pizza Boy, Taxi Driver)
findings.detail: 100% needs Vigilante L12, Paramedic L12, Firefighter L12 each in one go; Pizza Boy L10 in one go; Taxi 100 total fares (not one sitting). Rewards: Vigilante 150 armor, Pizza Boy 150 health, Paramedic unlimited sprint, Firefighter fireproof. Trophies: Running Rampant (Vig L12), Somebody Call the Wambulance? (Para L12), Point A to Point B (25 fares), High Quality H2O (10 fires), Pie Guy (10 pizzas).
findings.trackable: Level/fares shown in-mission; Stats menu unconfirmed.

findings.name: Sunshine Autos Import/Export
findings.detail: 4 lists (Street, Expensive, Sports, Unique Cars), 24 vehicles total. Trophy 'Grand Theft Auto' = all. Deluxo unlocks after first list.
findings.trackable: List shown at the garage; stats unconfirmed.

findings.name: Off-road missions
findings.detail: 4: PCJ Playground, Cone Crazy, Trial by Dirt, Test Track.

findings.name: RC missions
findings.detail: 3: RC Bandit Race, RC Baron Race, RC Raider Pickup. Trophy 'Just Like the Real Thing' = win RC Bandit Race.

findings.name: Street Races
findings.detail: 6: Terminal Velocity, Ocean Drive, Border Run, Capital Cruise, Tour!, V.C. Endurance; must win each.

findings.name: Hyman Memorial Stadium
findings.detail: 3: Hotring, Bloodring, Dirtring. Daily rotation, only startable 20:00-00:00 in-game.

findings.name: Chopper Checkpoints
findings.detail: 4: Ocean Beach, Vice Point, Little Haiti, Downtown. First three unlock after 'Rub Out', fourth after 'G-Spotlight'.

findings.name: Asset missions
findings.detail: 20 missions across properties: Boatyard 1 (Checkpoint Charlie), Cherry Popper 1 (Distribution, 50 ice creams), InterGlobal Studios 4, Kaufman Cabs 3, Malibu Club 4, Phil's Place 2, Print Works 2, Vercetti Estate 3, plus Sunshine Autos 4 lists and Pole Position Club ($300 on dance rooms). Assassinations 5: Road Kill, Waste the Wife, Autocide, Check Out at the Check In, Loose Ends (trophy Gun for Hire).

findings.name: Rifle Range / Safehouses / Properties
findings.detail: Rifle Range score >=45. Buy all 7 safehouses (~$41,500). Trophy Vice City Mogul = own 10 properties; Xbox 'Prime Real Estate' = all properties.

findings.name: 100% completion reward
findings.detail: Max health/armor 200, refilled ammo, double vehicle strength, Frankie outfit, up to 3 bodyguards at Vercetti Estate (GTAIntel: $2,000 each, infinite ammo). Achievement 'Done it All'.
findings.trackable: Completion % shown in Stats (standard in series; not confirmed for DE by fetched sources).

findings.name: Other stat-based achievements
findings.detail: Bull in a China Shop $1,000,000 damage; Break it Up $500,000; Offender 50 wanted stars; Target Practice 50 headshots; Retro Lewk wear every outfit; Bloodstained Hands (Butcher, 10,000 criminal rating); Take the Cannoli (Godfather, 100,000, needs patch 1.02+); I'm Famous (Stuff of Legends media rank 1,600+); One is Better Than Two (30s wheelie); Keepie-Uppy Okie Dokie (beach ball 5); Born in the 80's (all 9 radio stations). Several appear only in the Xbox/PC 43-list.
findings.trackable: Criminal rating, media attention and damage reported as pause-menu stats in sources (tips say pause to pop trophy).

trackableStats.stat: Criminal rating (Butcher/Godfather) and media attention rank
trackableStats.where: Implied by trophy guide (pause menu stats); exact screen not fetched
Stats menu (series standard); not confirmed for DE by fetched pages

versionNotes.note: PowerPyx guide is for PS4/PS5/Xbox/PC; no source found covering Switch-specific differences. PS list has 34 trophies; Social Club/Xbox list has 43 achievements (extra: Scouring the City!, Put 'Em Up, Break it Up, Prime Real Estate, Offender, Retro Lewk, Target Practice, Baked Distractions, etc.). Switch has no trophy system of its own; what Switch 2 offers is unknown.
Comments report possible Checkpoint Charlie 99% bug and Fidelity-mode crash; Boatyard glitch reportedly patched. Unverified.

gaps: Could not confirm where DE Stats menu displays each count (packages, rampages, jumps, robberies, fares, etc.) or the in-game completion percentage.
Package milestone rewards are from search summaries; sniper rifle name and exact spawn locations conflict. Progameguides returned 403.
No Switch/Switch 2-specific content or achievement info found.
Whether ice cream/Phil's/Malibu/Print Works/Kaufman missions are exactly the counts listed was single-source (PowerPyx).
